description: Hourly Electricity Demand Projections for Eight Combined Climate and Socioeconomic Scenarios is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Casey Burleyson, Zarrar Khan. This dataset contains 40 years (1980-2019) of simulated historical hourly electricity demand (i.e., loads) and 80 years (2020-2099) of projected hourly loads for 54 Balancing Authorities (BAs) and 48 states plus the District of Columbia. Details about the scenarios and variables included in this dataset are in the readme.pdf file. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
